entries.purpose: Convert Trusted RU diagnostic probe state into a routing decision preview and optional persisted decision state.
entries.direct_ru_behavior: Reads Direct/RU-sensitive diagnostic fields and emits TRUSTED_RU_SENSITIVE route-class decision text; no Direct/RU domain list write observed.
entries.policy_routing_influence: Does not call policy apply, routing sync, autoswitch, nft, ip route, or ip rule. Its persisted decision state and output can influence operator and downstream policy/routing decisions.
entries.gosuslugi_sensitive_behavior: Default domain set includes www.gosuslugi.ru, gosuslugi.ru, esia.gosuslugi.ru, lk.gosuslugi.ru, and alfa-mobile.alfabank.ru if policy domain config is absent.
entries.network_probe_behavior: No network probe observed directly; it evaluates existing diagnostic probe state.
entries.temp_backup_behavior: With --write-state, writes a temporary state file and mv's it to the decision state path.
entries.verification_requirement: bash -n only; do not execute against live Trusted RU state in lineage work.
entries.special_safety_notes: Preview mode is non-persistent by default, but --write-state mutates Trusted RU decision state. Timeout/stale diagnostic semantics can affect decision quality. Do not treat as proof that Gosuslugi routing is safe.

entries.purpose: Refresh missing Trusted RU diagnostics for a bounded number of domains and recalculate persisted decision state.
entries.mutation_level: Trusted-RU-refresh diagnostic-state-read diagnostic-state-write decision-state-write network-probe route-class-influence
decision_state_writes: Invokes v7-trusted-ru-decision --write-state before/after refresh as needed
route_class_reads: Trusted RU decision items from trusted-ru-decision.state
entries.direct_ru_behavior: Does not mutate Direct/RU domain lists directly, but invokes Trusted RU diagnostic behavior for selected domains.
entries.policy_routing_influence: Does not call policy apply, routing sync, autoswitch, nft, ip route, or ip rule directly. It refreshes diagnostic/decision state that can influence downstream operator and policy decisions.
entries.gosuslugi_sensitive_behavior: Can trigger probes for domains previously classified MISSING_DIAGNOSTIC, including Gosuslugi-sensitive domains from the decision state.
entries.network_probe_behavior: Calls v7-trusted-ru-diagnostic for selected domains; that diagnostic can perform DNS, curl, VLESS/SOCKS, AWG, OpenSSL, and Direct/RU route checks.
entries.audit_behavior: No v7-audit-log call observed in this wrapper.
entries.temp_backup_behavior: No local temp file observed in wrapper; delegated diagnostic/decision tools may write tmp state files.
entries.verification_requirement: bash -n only; do not execute because it can trigger live Gosuslugi/Trusted RU probes and state writes.
entries.special_safety_notes: Not read-only. Even the NOOP path recalculates decision state with --write-state. Live execution is forbidden in lineage work.
